name: 46662-thinkbudget-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1: one engine process, one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, max_requests=64 (ONE round of 64, so the batch is exactly 64 deep from the first decode step to the last), safety_seconds 2400, warmup percent 0.0. One round cannot discard a round: the percent sizes the warmup PHASE and a request is excluded only if it finished before the phase boundary, and with all 64 dispatched together that boundary is the run's own start whatever the percent is. It is declared 0.0 so the file says what happens. Re-derive it if max_requests changes.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape and zero variance: 512 prompt tokens and exactly 8192 output tokens per request, temperature 0.6 / top_p 0.95, with `thinking_token_budget: 4096` on EVERY request. guidellm sets ignore_eos whenever a request carries an output-token count, so every request runs the full 8192 tokens and the budget is reached halfway through. The declaration is closed: nothing not listed here or in vllm-config.yaml is set.
purpose: A reasoning assistant generating long 8k-token answers with a capped thinking budget for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine command line. The commit is `commit_id` in setupcard.md; the interpreter and the
# hardware are configs/env.yaml (per-machine, not portable).
#
# ONE LAUNCH ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE IS PART OF THIS CONFIG and cannot be written as an engine
# argument: VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0. The engine already selects the V1 model runner for this
# config at this commit; pinning it keeps a change of default from moving the setup onto another.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B

# REQUIRED: without a reasoning parser the engine builds no thinking-budget state at all and every
# request's `thinking_token_budget` is inert. `deepseek_r1` is this checkpoint's registered parser
# and supplies the <think> / </think> delimiters the budget is counted between.
reasoning-parser: deepseek_r1

speculative-config: {"method": "ngram", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "prompt_lookup_min": 5, "prompt_lookup_max": 5}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 16384

# RESOLVED, NOT DEFAULTS. Do not delete either line as redundant: they are what a real
# `vllm serve` picks on a card this size, while an in-process engine falls through to 2048 / 128.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
